description: A fungal disease that causes soft rot on cucurbit fruits such as cucumber, melon, and pumpkin. It mainly affects ripe or damaged fruits and produces a white mold that later becomes sour and watery.
symptoms: White cottony mold on infected areas
Fruit tissue becomes soft and collapses
Sour or fermented smell from infected fruit
Rot usually starts at wounds or damaged areas
spread: Wounds caused during harvest or transport
management: Handle fruits carefully to avoid wounds
biological_control: Use beneficial microbes such as Trichoderma species to suppress fungal growth
Apply Bacillus-based biofungicides to reduce pathogen development
chemical_control: Sanitation with approved disinfectants to reduce contamination
prevention: Avoid fruit injuries during harvest and transport
Store fruits in cool and dry conditions
source: Plant pathology references on cucurbit post-harvest diseases
